Missions.Title: Prologue
Missions.Description:
Year 2049

Long time ago scientists discovered an ancient artifact. They used it to create a new type of technology called BlasterTech. This technology was first used to make airships capable of traveling through space faster and easier. It was a big step for humanity towards interstellar exploration and conquest. 

Oliver, a 29 years old pilot, married with a wife and a little girl, graduated as the best pilot in his class. He accepted the offer to test out the new prototype ship and travel into space. From all the candidates, he was the most qualified and best suited for the job. The first test run objectives seemed easy to Oliver. He was confident everything  would run smoothly. The blast off was a success and soon enough he was flying in space.  The mission was going well until he noticed something pop up on the radar. 

Ships suddenly appeared in the far distance and were travelling very fast towards Earth. Oliver tried to communicate with HQ but something was blocking  the communications. He waited to see what their true intentions were. He got his answer when they opened fire on him. He knew he was in danger and so was Earth. 

Years of training kicked in and Oliver maneuvered his ship quickly, avoiding major damage. He didn't want to engage with the unknown ships, hoping that there was a way to resolve this without violence.

After a few minutes, Oliver realised he couldn’t not engage with the enemy,  their intentions were clearly to destroy him.  He did not have any other choice but to fight back.

Missions.Title: Mission 1
Missions.Description:
After Oliver manage to reflect the Enemy Attack and he felt relief seeing them retreating finally. He was suprised with the capabilities of this ship. He never seen such power before. With that he finally managed to send a message to HQ and explain what happened and with that he returned home. He received praise for his bravery and skills everyone. The saw them and tried to communicate with him to warn him but they communication were down for some reason. They had an idea of why though. Oliver successfully completed the mission and manage to come back alive even after that difficult challenge although the ship was quite beat up and it would take long before it will fly again but they were determined to try again as soon as possible.

Few years Passed since that day and scientists build a new improved version of the ship and Oliver was once again in the cockpit and flying around exploring the capabilities and limitations. Not long after that HQ started sending Oliver to various missions around the world. Helping people in need and sometimes used in favor of the government. 

 One day HQ asked Oliver to go and check a strange signal coming off in the near grasslands and see report back.

While flying above the grasslands everything seem normal. He was about to turn around and call it a day. Suddenly he got hit but something. His ship had shield capabilities so he wasn't affected. He turn around to see what was that and in his surprise he saw a lot of spaceships coming toward him. They were the same as years back! He thought to himself.

‘Not this again’ This time around he send a message though his radio and send a warning to whoever could be listening. He got no answer. As the forces coming close to him he was getting nervous and did not know what to do. He tried to communicate with HQ but there was quite interference and the only thing he could hear “We are … Under Attack.. I repeat … we are under attack... “ and with that he knew. That the attack few years ago was just the start.

He could hear in the distance sound of battle and smoke . The city was under attack and his family was in danger and with that he tried to fly toward the city but unfortunately the enemies block his way to the city. 
“So…” he thought “the only way is thought them heh? So be it! No one will stand between me and my family!” He shouted and with that the fight began.

Missions.Title: Mission 2
Missions.Description:
After Oliver defeated the enemies in the grass lands without wasting any more time he made course to the city. Ariving at the city he noticed all the destruction and battle that was still going on. Solider were fighting and try to evacuate the people. Before join the fight he first had to make sure his family was ok and manage to go away. He fly down the ship near his home hidden from anyone who might come by and run towards his house. He went though the town streets , around he could see only destruction and corpses. We werent prepared for this he though to himself “I hope they are fine”.

Few minutes he barge into his apartment and started shouting for his wife “Jayne are you here?” He looked around real quickly on all rooms. Nowhere to be found but he noticed the bedroom was a mess and cloths were missing so he thought that they really did left in time. With that hope in his heart he return to his ship and fly towards the sound of battle. 

Until now there were no communication between Earth and the Aliens but a strange broadcast could be heard from all over the world.  The message is translated as: -We are Maos , Resistance is futile, Surrender or Die trying’ he was surprised but instead of focusing on that message he decided to go help the people and give them time to evacuate.

Missions.Title: Mission 3
Missions.Description:
The battle was rough and soon enough the city was overwhelmed with Maos forces. The people who manage to evacuate they were moved to a secure underground facility far away from the city and Oliver retreat as well after giving some time for the soldier to take everyone to the transport ships.

That was the first raid of many that will happen and eventually Earth Fall.

Year has passed since the fall and earth and government knew that they can't win against their Alien Enemies so instead they asked for negotiation with them in hopes that no more people will die and maybe it is the only way to survive as a species.

Oliver was against this idea because he knew that if we do that we will live a life of slavary and who knows what their version of slavary might be. The Government had decide and they ignored his warnings with anger and frustration he left and took his ship with him even if they decline his request. 

And with that Earth was occupied by Maos and the people who surrendered were captured and moved somewhere. We don't know where exactly. Very quickly Government regret their decision but it was too late. Everyone who opposed them or trying to resist they got either killed or taken away to never hear or see them again. No one has heard or seen Olvier since that day until months later where a small team of resistance started looking for him. He was the only one who could fight this Maos and he was the only one who the tech to do it. 

Oliver decided to join their efforts and find a way to defeat Maos and free the world from their grasps. In addition to that he had a mission of his own. His family was still missing and he didn't know where they are but he was determined to find out. He hoped deep in his heart that they were alright and Maos didn’t get them.

The first goal for the resistance was to collect resources and information so their first Target was a place hidden in the near ocean.

Missions.Title: Mission 4
Missions.Description:
After the success of gathering some useful material on the near ocean where lot of Enemy Ship were destroyed. He found some useful Intel about a secret base in space where Alien used to spy on Earth under their nose. We need to destroy that. Oliver said to the resistance. Everyone was skeptical and how can we do that? They asked him. That is true he was the only one with a ship capable of reaching the Moon. He smiled and unsure them that he was 100  percent of this but he had a plan. Oliver knew a lot about engineering and airships so he would help the resistance make more spaceships and create a crew of skilled people that are going to be the first line of defence, hopefully they will have the Advantage of Surprise."

So Cheetah and The Hive are created. This ships were created with different goals in mind. Cheetah was fast but vulnerable to attacks. The Hive used drones to help them in combat and also offer support. The original ship was called Vulture and it was a balance and most efficient from all three.

Sam one bright engineer who lost everything in the battle and managed to escape at the last moment he joined the resistance to help with maintaining their vehicles and ships. Oliver saw her talent and decided to invite her to join his crew. Everyone knew about him he was famous for his battle in the city and against the Enemies. She was happy and accepted without hesitation. She helped and build the Hive and later on she became her pilot.

Pete one of the computer expert on the resistance who he was responsible for establishing communications and internal systems. He joined the crew as Oliver saw he was someone that could be trusted. Although Pete never had flough a spaceship before he knew a lot about them. It didn't take long till he figured out how to fly one. And with the help from Oliver he quickly become really good at it. With that later on he becomes the pilot of the “Cheetah”

Few months passed and the team was ready for their first assignment. Oliver , Sam and Pete joined forces and decided to give the moon a visit and see what is going on there.

Some other resistance members joined Joe a young female a old friend of Oliver who surprisingly find her way there.  Oliver was really happy to see her there and he hoped she knew something about his family but she did not. Oliver and Joe were together since University and they got the pilot certificate the same year. 

WIth that everyone took their place and fly towards the moon.

Missions.Title: Mission 5
Missions.Description:
Their arrival to the moon was a success , everything seemed to be normal. Nothing out of the ordinary.
Something got Oliver eye something shiny and transparent he moved closer to investigate. Before he reach it he immediately notice the building and the shield surround it. It was apparent that the intel was indeed correct and their mission was clear.

They had to destroy the Maos base on the moon to stop them from spying on our every moon.  The question was how we are going to do that? It also seems they haven't noticed us yet. He though but soon enough alien ship arrived and attack without warning. 

The fight was rough and a lot of good people lost their lives. Oliver was starting to get nervous they couldn't keep it up and they should find a way to inside that protection barrier and destroy the city. “Hey! I think i found a way” Pete said on the radio “There there is a generator hidden behind the rocks” Oliver looked at the rocks and he was right it was difficult to notice them before. 

We few calculated shots the generator was blown off and the protection barrier was down. Without hesitation oliver ordered the crew and the fleet to attack and finish the job.

So everyone moved in the alien city and did exactly that. And soon enough they succeed without any issue. It seem that the Maos did not predicted their attack and weren't prepared.

Everyone was happy that the mission was a success but soon enough Oliver noticed something big coming their way and what he saw shocked him. It was a big one which appeared from nowhere and started shooting down any resistance ship. “Retreat! Everyone let's get the hell out of here immidiatly” He ordered and with that he also made his way out. 

On his way to escape suddenly his ship was stunned and idle. He lost control and soon enough he saw a beam from the big ship captured him. This is bad he thought really bad and tried his best to escape but the energy beam was too strong.

He was ready to give up when suddenly something hit his ship and freed him from the beam and once again had control. He didn't understand how and why but he soon saw Joe his best friend push his ship away from the bean and take his place instead “Joe! What are you doing?!” he shouted “I am sorry Oliver but they need you, dont worry about me, I can take care of myself now go! While you have time “ He knew she was right but he couldn't just let her sacrifice herself like that but he didn't have a choice. He took a deep breath and looked away and fly away “Take care of yourself and I will be back for you, I promise,” he said to the radio and with tears in his eyes escaped.

Missions.Title: Mission 6
Missions.Description:
Returning home everyone was devastated they lost so many people , good people but Oliver was determined not to let that go to waste. He immediately decided what his next plan would be. Now that they destroyed the base on the moon, it is time to take their fight to their territory. I small intel suggested there's an Alien planet like construction where all their Operation is happen. If they manage to take care of it they will definitely cripple them and will make their lives easier in freeing cities and bring them closer to freedom.

In addition he also learned that most people who got captured they were taken there.so it was a good opportunity to go look if they indeed captured his family or not. 

It took a few days of preparation and there was another message broadcasting around the world. “We Maos are not going to tolerate any resistance. The people who were responsible for destroying many crucial operations if they are not surrender we will forced to punish everyone.” 

Oliver knew that their attack made them angry and they didn't had enough time and they had to act quick before innocent people get hurt. He ordered everyone to prepare and that this is going to be their last big attack against Maos. “We are going to hit them in their own territory, We will prove to them not to mess with us”

Same was worried about Oliver he lost his best friend and he acted cool but she knew deep down he was sad. She tried to talk with him and make sure everyone was alright but he assured her that everything is ok and she should focus on the mission at hand. There is no time to waste  and with that she left without saying anything. 

The Resistance got ready and fly to the Alien Planet.

Their arrival was met with resistance and Oliver knew it was now or never and ordered everyone to attack. This is for everyone that sacrificed and so the battle begins.

Missions.Title: Mission 7
Missions.Description:
Enemy was resilience to protect their Planet and their base. Battle was not as difficuilt as Oliver Imagined. He and his crew managed to go through their line of defence quite easily and enter deeper into the City.. They were deep inside and there was no way back, no they have to finish this. Oliver was surprised how easy this was and was worried that this might be a trap but then again how did they knew they will come? The only way it would be if someone on their ranks is leaking information to the enemy. He can’t imagine that someone will betray his own species like that. He put that though on the side and focus on the mission at hand. As he enter deeper into the base he noticed those curcle that move around the base. He didn't know what those were used maybe some kind of power generation or something? As they kept moving though the building the defence here weren't very strong but as they went further enemies started to appear and try to stop them. We are on the right track it seems as they followed the line of circles more and more enemy troops arrived to stop them from going further. That did not stop them from pushing further until they find a way to shut down the enemy operations. 

Oliver noticed some strange movement on the ground floor so when he made sure they were clear “I am going to check something out keep moving forward and keep me posted and be careful!”  said to the rest as he changed course to lower ground of the base. “Oliver? Where you going? Did you find something?” Sam asked curiously as he noticed him leaving formation “ I don’t know yet just keep going I will let you know as soon as I find something” Oliver did not know what to find down there but he had to go check. 

The it the area he was right now  was dark and hard to see it, it seem it was a tunnel that was leading somewhere. Finally he heard noises and at the end of the tunnel was light. Oliver was shocked as he saw a big device in the middle as people were transferring something on their backs into the device. He had no words to describe what he was seeing. He knew that when they captured people they will probably made them work or do something but he had no idea. He also noticed that everyone had blank expressions they were just moving without thinking like they are hypnotised or something. That was the time he knew that he had to destroy this machine and maybe everyone will had to go away. 

“Oliver do you copy?” A familiar voice was heard over the Radio breaking the silent and bring Olvier and reality. “Yes What is it?” “We can’t find anything” Pete complained, “I think I find our target you won't believe what they are doing to our people” |He said in the radio while holding strong into the wheel of his ship. “What ?” everyone on the radio asked but Oliver did not want to waste time “Prepare for retreat and generally for anything unexpected “ and with that he pushed forward into the big machine and with few shots everything started to shake as big earthquake hit the area. Is the machine doing this? He thought and he keep shooting it until it finally pieces started falling down and the machine suddenly stopped working and small explodes happen all over the place. All the people that were moving suddenly stopped and started screaming loudly. What the hell ? What did they do to this poor people. Enemy ships appeared and hunt him down but he was too fast for them as he took the down quickly. 

Out of nowhere a big explosion and lava flow thought the machine and slowly fill the whole area. Without losing time he ordered his crew to come to his aid and try to help these people and take them away from this area as it was certain that the whole area is about to get filled by Lava.



Some couriers arrived as Sam was there with them. Courier landed near there and the resistant soldiers moved to secure the people that were just standing there. Everything seemed to be ok but when the soldier approach this people they got attacked by them. Screams in the radio and Oliver and the team was shocked “What the hell? Have they lost their minds?!” Pete said as he also arrived a few moments before the scene.

Oliver looked at the situation and couldn't understand what was going on  “Enemies incoming! Oliver we have to leave! We are going to get surrounded” Sam warned in the radio. For a moment he just stood there looking at the scene in front of him. While staring at the people on the ground he noticed a woman. She looked familiar as he looked closer at her then it hit him. The hope he had went away and anger filled him as the realisation that the woman in front of him was his lost wife. 
“Oliver! What are we going to do? We have to retreat the whole place is going down!” Pete said over the radio.
After few minutes of silent finally Sam and Pete heard Oliver “Leave I have to take care of something” He didn't say anything else he fly toward the people where the woman was “Oliver what are you doing?!” Pete said as he saw but Sam interrupted him as he also noticed the woman “Pete let go he will be alright lets give him some time”

Sam and Pete moved to clear the enemies forces as the lava started to fill the whole planet. Sam was worried that he will do something stupid but he trusted him that he will do the right thing. She knew these people are gone and as sad as it may be he hoped Oliver doesn’t blame himself for it.

Missions.Title: Mission 8
Missions.Description:
Sam and Pete cleared the path out of the base and escaped but Oliver was nowhere to be seen. The plane was completely filled with Lava and everything that was there now completely destroyed. They made their way back home. On the way back more Enemy forces appear they seem to not be organised and they seem to be panicked their home was destroyed. 

Sam and Pete returned home victorious and they decided to rest for a few days and wait for Oliver  to show signs that he lives.  They also had to come up with the next plan. The next few days there was no signal from Oliver and the resistance continued their missions normally. Their effort at the alien planet seem to had been really successful as most of the alien that occupied Earth seem to have left and only left few forces still around.

The resistance managed to free many cities and towns around the globe as the people who survived and were hiding they finally come out. It was like their prayers had answer finally they were free and although their lives won't be like before they can rebuild. Sam did not know where Oliver is and if he is still alive but he hoped that he is, as she was preparing for the final battle.

The alien who were still on Earth made a Final attack against the Resistance and Sam and Pete were ready to defeat and end this for once and for all.
